about: The rows of Model > Game review (R-454, R-455, R-492): every situation the engine reads in each review game, with the engine's confidence that it is a decision, written by tools/golden/review.py export on the engine branch. Games with scheme 2 are graded his new way; the others are history (R-491). His marks are in game_review_marks.json, never here.
